show: The Mess Around with Hannah and Lamorne

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst art19.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Revisiting New Girl season six, episode nine with behind-the-scenes stories
kurzfassung: The hosts review season six, episode nine of New Girl, discussing the newly built sets and the character layers revealed for Robbie. They examine the comedic dynamics of the episode, including a disastrous double date and a contractor mishap. The episode concludes with listener questions about how the cast originally got into comedic acting.
stichpunkte: Discussion of season six, episode nine of New Girl, written by Rob Roselle and directed by Trent O'Donnell
Analysis of new sets built for the season, including the outdoor cafe and the construction area
Exploration of the relationship status dilemma between Jess and Robbie
Praise for guest star Nelson Franklin and his multi-faceted character Robbie
Behind-the-scenes insights into shooting single-camera versus multi-camera sitcom formats
Schmidt and Nick's bumbling attempt to handle home contractors and retrieve stolen copper pipes
A chaotic double date featuring handmade wine and an unexpected Greek rave
Answering a listener's question about the hosts' journeys into comedic acting

kapitel.titel: Pipe Retrieval and the Tech Disco

clips.text: The hosts joke about the creepy, dungeon-like state of an old basement that prompted an assistant to flee the town in fear.
The speakers discuss how a casual comment about filming formats was aggressively twisted into misleading headlines by online media.

clips.hook: Luxury cashmere at a lower cost
clips.text: The host highlights affordable everyday essentials made from premium materials like Mongolian cashmere and 14-karat gold.
The hosts praise the writers for subverting expectations by giving Robbie an unexpectedly accomplished and fascinating backstory.

clips.hook: Growing up as the family clown
clips.text: A host shares a childhood memory of being labeled the family clown by his father, which eventually sparked his passion for comedy.

beschreibung:
We're back for another round of Recording In A Cursed House! But ya know what? Es all good. Our silly goose hosts reminisce about their light load in this episode (but important one!), and admire the comedy skills of their costars. They also chat about their own comedy influences!
